title: VINFAST ANNOUNCES STRONG GLOBAL DELIVERIES IN 3Q25
summary: October 29, 2026 – VinFast Auto Ltd. (“VinFast” or the “Company”) today announced its preliminary vehicle deliveries for the third quarter of 2026 and an additional capital contribution by Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong, the Company’s founder and a director, to VinFast Vietnam Joint Stock Company (“VFVN”), a subsidiary of the Company.
body_markdown:
***October 29, 2026 – VinFast Auto Ltd. (“VinFast” or the “Company”) today announced its preliminary vehicle deliveries for the third quarter of 2026 and an additional capital contribution by Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong, the Company’s founder and a director, to VinFast Vietnam Joint Stock Company (“VFVN”), a subsidiary of the Company.***


******


*The Company delivered 82,580 electric vehicles (“EVs”) globally in the third quarter of 2026, representing a 116% increase year-over-year.*


**


*During the third quarter of 2026, the VF 3 and Limo Green were the best-selling models, with deliveries of 21,744 and 19,100 vehicles, respectively. The Company also delivered 10,329 VF 5 vehicles, 7,519 VF 6 vehicles, 5,097 Herio Green vehicles, 3,893 VF 7 vehicles, and 3,411 VF 8 vehicles during the period. Cumulatively, in the first nine months of 2026, VinFast delivered 211,242 EVs to customers globally, representing a 91% increase year-over-year.*


**


*VinFast also delivered 284,831 e-scooters and e-bikes globally during the third quarter of 2026, representing a 137% increase year-over-year, of which 281,409 units were delivered in Vietnam. Cumulatively, in the first nine months of 2026, VinFast delivered 714,006 e-scooters and e-bikes globally, representing a 204% increase year-over-year. Among these deliveries, the Evo and Feliz continued to lead VinFast’s sales, accounting for approximately 57% and 26% of total two-wheeler deliveries, respectively.*


***About VinFast***


**


*VinFast (NASDAQ: VFS) – a subsidiary of Vingroup JSC – is Vietnam’s leading automotive company, committed to its mission of creating a green future for everyone. VinFast offers a range of electric SUVs, e-scooters, e-bikes, and e-buses in Vietnam and exports to key markets across Asia, North America, and Europe. Learn more at www.vinfastauto.us.*


*VinFast deliveries represent only one measure of the Company’s financial performance and should not be relied on as an indicator of quarterly financial results, which depend on a variety of factors, including vehicle selling prices and various cost components.*
